name: Outbound Access Protection for Data Warehouse
description: Fabric administrators want to ensure that data in Fabric isnt exfiltrated to unpermitted destinations outside of Fabric unintentionally or by due to  malicious intent . In this milestone, we will provide controls to ensure Data Warehouse in a Fabric workspace can only connect to approved endpoints. The date for GA is currently a placeholder. We'll update that once we have clarity on GA dates.
